name: CAMS Global Atmospheric Composition Reanalysis (EAC4)
description: The CAMS Reanalysis (EAC4 - ECMWF Atmospheric Composition Reanalysis 4) is the flagship global atmospheric chemistry dataset produced by the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service. Spanning 2003 to the present at approximately 80 km horizontal resolution across 60 vertical pressure levels with 3-hourly temporal resolution, EAC4 assimilates satellite observations into the ECMWF IFS chemistry module. It provides continuous 3D fields of reactive gases (ozone, nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, sulphur dioxide), greenhouse gases, and aerosol optical properties partitioned into dust, sea salt, black carbon, organic matter, and sulphate.
